value.rationale: Identifies a motivated qualitative false-inference boundary for pollutant monitoring and quantifies the fraction of misleading grab-sample times by a frequency-count-dependent critical exponent. The exact sharp threshold distinguishes benign timing offsets from those permitting fictitious contamination gains, a meaningful structural sensitivity not supplied by qualitative warnings to use Lagrangian sampling. Uses a precisely stated idealized physical domain; field validation and finite-window rates are unproved.
